title: [Switch] Suikoden I & II HD $27, Rune Factory GoA $34, Super Mario RPG $39, Xenoblade Chronicles X $44 + Del ($0 C&C) @ EB Games
body:
Deal: [Switch] Suikoden I & II HD $27, Rune Factory GoA $34, Super Mario RPG $39, Xenoblade Chronicles X $44 + Del ($0 C&C) @ EB Games

[maverickjohn] Suikoden was a great game never played it on the psx. Played the remaster on ps5 and surprisingly enjoyed it. Didn't expect to.
I ordered rune factory for switch 2 always happy to add another jrpg.
[mangobango] Hopefully Suikoden is still in stock in a couple of hours for us non-EB world plus plebs.
[mangobango] Was able to nab a copy of both this and Rune Factory, thanks OP!
[muwu] Super Mario RPG is a classic and a delightful play in 2026, recommend.
Princess Peach… you can skip that one. Maybe for a younger kid if the price is a deep cut.
[vongz] Suikoden II, what a great game. Highly recommend it ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ for me.
[bugsbunny] For those Suikoden fans, there’s an anime in the works to be released around October and I am so pumped. It’s based off Suikoden 2.
[not boris becker] Impulse buy territory for Rune Factory, thanks.
For anyone with a Switch 2, worth mentioning there's no upgrade path for Suikoden to the Switch 2 version… Though with the boost mode functionality they added a couple months ago, you'll get 1080p handheld with the Switch 1 version anyway (30fps vs 60fps and 1440p docked being the only differences).
[jeimuzu] Got NES champs and Rune Factory. Thanks OP
